title: 2025 AMC 10B Problem 2
statement: Jerry wrote down the ones digit of each of the first \(2025\) positive squares: \(1,\) \(4,\) \(9,\) \(6,\) \(5,\) \(6,\) \(\ldots\) What is the sum of all the numbers Jerry wrote down?

solutions.text: The ones digit of \(n^2\) depends only on the ones digit of \(n,\) so the list repeats every \(10\) terms: \(1, 4, 9, 6, 5, 6, 9, 4, 1, 0.\) One block sums to \(45.\) Now \(2025 = 202 \cdot 10 + 5,\) so we get \(202\) full blocks plus the first five terms: \(202 \cdot 45\) \(+ (1 + 4 + 9 + 6 + 5)\) \(= 9090\) \(+ 25 = 9115.\) Therefore, the answer is D.
hints: The ones digit of \(n^2\) depends only on the ones digit of \(n,\) so the list repeats every \(10\) terms
One full block \(1, 4, 9, 6, 5, 6, 9, 4, 1, 0\) sums to \(45;\) there are \(202\) full blocks and \(5\) leftover terms
